The documentation uses the self-contained browser bundle. Its optional remote
decoder paths are not used: scripts/docs/check_links.py rejects GLBs that use
Draco, Meshopt or Basis Universal compression and rejects external buffer or
image URIs. Review models must therefore be standalone, embedded GLB files.
